## Choppy v1.27

📋⚡ Windows 10 / 11 - fast, clear file copier ⚡ everything that matters in one plain, dark window.

### What's in v1.27
- **Adaptive, measured on your PC:** a big enough file is copied in a few short stretches first, each another way (piece size, pieces in flight, reading and writing at once or one after the other); the fastest way copies the rest and the next big files of the copy. The badge shows *tuned* when it switched.
- **Many small files on local drives:** Choppy tries more files at once and keeps that only when it is measurably faster.

### Install / Update
1. Download **Choppy-v1.27.zip** and extract all files (or use the PowerShell one-liner from the README).
2. Double-click **Activate Choppy.cmd** (or run `build.ps1` and choose **[1]**).
3. Remove at any time with **Revert to Windows Copy.cmd**.
